verses.text: The Eternal reigns, clothed in majesty; He is dressed in power; He has surrounded Himself with strength. He has established the world, and it will never be toppled.
Your throne was established from the beginning of the world, O God, and You are everlasting.
The waters have risen, O Eternal One; the sound of pounding waves is deafening. The waters have roared with power.
More powerful than the thunder of mighty rivers, more powerful than the mighty waves in the ocean is the Eternal on high!
Your teachings are true; Your decrees sure. Sacredness adorns Your house, O Eternal One, forevermore.
